note: Preview gallery of the ecolog tree window («Науковий термінал») for ui_gallery index=preview/ecolog.json. The window's root is the whole host, the 1600x900 stage centred in it. Fixtures only set texts and show the skin's hidden parts (capitals with the Latin I, as OZL_Text.Upper writes them for the vanilla Metron): ecolog-window -- the header and three pool instruments (the live window shares the row's width out by the number of lines; here they keep the four-line width); ecolog-card -- the protocol of a node being researched (bold clock, 20 segments); ecolog-node -- a selected node being researched. What the skin lays out at run time (tier labels, the price under a node, the opens chips, the close key) needs the live menu: world_exec oz_research treeui. A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire.
